text: 1930 removes the JavaScript-specific early return from the Zimbra-version test. The current task checks six versions, with expected LIST (SUBSCRIBED) behavior changing at 7.2.3 and 8.0.3, and closes cached connections before each expand. Inbox update supplies an awaited listener because performExpand has none. This is a scoped test pattern for version-sensitive protocol behavior; the cited comment reports server crashes in older versions, but no crash or native protocol transaction was reproduced here. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: The retained IMAP subscribed-list test includes server-version cases without a JS skip
